title: ApprovalArtifactV1
description: Signed attestation that a human reviewer approved a specific action. Verified by the evaluate path before issuing a permit_token. The agent cannot self-declare authority; the artifact is bound to the exact action via action_hash, signed by a trusted issuer, and replay-protected via nonce. Wire-stable as `approval_artifact.v1`.

meaning.description: Optional, additive (added 2026-10-03). 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a)(2) signature meaning: what the signature signifies. Covered by the artifact signature. When absent the runtime records the historical implied meaning "approved". Mirrors atlasent-api _shared/approval_artifact.ts SignatureMeaning; a value outside this closed set is rejected by the runtime verifier.

entra_provenance.description: Optional, additive (added 2026-10-03). Entra tenant-binding and authority-mapping facts v1-idp-broker resolved when minting this approver envelope; present only when the provider was Entra ID and the action type was governed at mint time. relation is always "approve" on an approval artifact. Covered by the artifact signature.

approval_kind.description: Optional, additive (ADR CROSS-056, added 2026-10-03). Absent means an ordinary human approval. "single_human_over_machine" is the agent owner approving one action by one key-bound agent named by subject_agent_identity_id; it satisfies requires_human_approval only, never a quorum, independent-approval or role-covered requirement. Accepted only from an issuer whose trusted-issuer entry declares this kind (enforced by the runtime, not this schema). Covered by the artifact signature.

subject_agent_identity_id.description: Optional, additive (ADR CROSS-056, added 2026-10-03). agent_identities.id (uuid, case-insensitive) the approval is FOR. Required when approval_kind is present and rejected when it is absent. Covered by the artifact signature.

approver_grant_assertion.description: Optional, additive (atlasent-api#3863 / #3876, 2026-10-03). The console-signed approver_grant_assertion.v1 that authorized this approval under the atlasent_approver_grant basis. An alternative to identity_assertion, never alongside it. Covered by the artifact signature. The runtime admits it only from an approval issuer whose trusted-issuer entry declares identity_basis "approver_grant", and only inside an approval reevaluation of this exact approval; artifacts without this field validate and verify exactly as before.

org_authority_assertion.description: Optional, additive (atlasent-api#3798 B2a, 2026-10-03). The console-signed org_authority_assertion.v1 that authorized this approval under the atlasent_verified_org_authority basis: an owner or admin of the approval's org, after a server-side step-up. An alternative to identity_assertion and approver_grant_assertion, never alongside either. Covered by the artifact signature. The runtime admits it only from an approval issuer whose trusted-issuer entry declares identity_basis "org_authority", only inside an approval reevaluation of this exact approval, and only for an org_role the approval's snapshot admits; reviewer.principal_id must equal the assertion's subject.principal_id. Artifacts without this field validate and verify exactly as before.

not.description: identity_assertion and approver_grant_assertion are alternatives: an artifact carrying both is rejected by the runtime verifier.
identity_assertion and org_authority_assertion are alternatives (added 2026-10-03, atlasent-api#3798 B2a).
approver_grant_assertion and org_authority_assertion are alternatives (added 2026-10-03, atlasent-api#3798 B2a).
